Finance/collections options I recommend (pros/cons):
1) Issue a customer credit note for the VAT amount (we absorb the VAT risk) — fastest to close, reduces AR days but sets a one-off precedent.
2) Issue a credit note conditioned on a short agreement clause (customer confirms reverse-charge in writing) — slightly slower but mitigates risk.
3) Hold firm: require formal VAT reg evidence; let them go through 10–14 day cycle — protects us but risks losing goodwill and delays revenue recognition.

- Monica: can you prepare a draft credit note (Credit_Note_Draft.docx) and dunning hold schedule so we can issue quickly if approved?
